title: In UsbDialogHelper of UsbDialogHelper.java, there is a possible UI confusion due to misleading or… (CVE-2026-55257)
description: CVE-2026-55257 is a vulnerability in the UsbDialogHelper component of UsbDialogHelper.java that causes possible user interface confusion due to misleading or insufficient UI. This flaw can lead to local privilege escalation without requiring additional execution privileges or user interaction.
